allies.rationale_text: Confidence-calibration gives dunning-kruger-effect the practical measurement discipline needed to compare self-belief against actual performance.
allies.source_quote: Calibration: regularly use objective instruments like quizzes, practice tests, or external review processes.
allies.affinity_rationale: Provides the systematic methodology for correcting the self-assessment failures that DKE describes — where DKE diagnoses the miscalibration, confidence-calibration offers the tools to remedy it.
allies.activation_condition: When self-assessment of competence needs systematic calibration methods to overcome the metacognitive blindness that DKE describes

allies.rationale_text: Intellectual-humility helps dunning-kruger-effect create the mindset needed to admit what is not yet known well enough.
allies.source_quote: The essential antidotes are radical open-mindedness and humility.
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical describes intellectual humility and radical open-mindedness as 'essential antidotes to the DKE' — the disposition that makes DKE awareness actionable by acknowledging what one doesn't know.
allies.activation_condition: When genuine acknowledgment of knowledge gaps is needed to overcome the overconfidence that DKE produces in low-competence domains

antagonists.rationale_text: WYSIATI undermines dunning-kruger-effect awareness by letting individuals construct a coherent-feeling story from sparse evidence, which inflates confidence and suppresses the metacognitive signal that competence is lacking.
antagonists.source_quote: This confidence is often based on the quality of the 'story' they can tell, even when evidence is sparse (WYSIATI).
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Directly maps to the knowledge-gap blindness that DKE describes — WYSIATI causes individuals to build confident narratives from available information without recognizing what information they are missing.
antagonists.activation_condition: When confident self-assessments are built from the visible evidence alone, without recognizing the vast unknown-unknowns that actual competence would reveal

structured_tensions.tension_text: Dunning-kruger-effect conflicts with confidence-calibration when awareness of the effect causes competent individuals to systematically underweight their own expertise.
structured_tensions.source_quote: dunning-kruger-effect conflicts with confidence-calibration (confidence calibration) when awareness of the effect causes competent individuals to systematically underweight their own expertise.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Dunning-kruger-effect conflicts with authority-bias when perceived expertise is granted to the confidently incompetent while genuinely skilled individuals defer unnecessarily.
structured_tensions.source_quote: dunning-kruger-effect conflicts with authority-bias (authority bias) when perceived expertise is granted to the confidently incompetent while genuinely skilled individuals defer unnecessarily.
